prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, an already finished 1448x1086 transparent 12-frame Tia ultimate sprite sheet. This is ONLY an effect-width/gutter correction, not a redraw of the characters. Maintain the canvas 1448x1086 and the 4 columns by 3 rows.
Absolutely preserve every existing Tia character in all twelve frames: exact two-head proportions, head size, face, facial expressions, hair outline and shading, clothes and trims, pose silhouette, crouch depth, hands and existing physical brush orientation. Preserve the current coarse square-pixel drawing style, shading colors and overall design. Keep frames 1-4 and 9-12 visually identical. Keep all twelve action beats and the last-row RGB droplets shrinking and disappearing exactly as shown.
The ONLY changes are to the RED/YELLOW/BLUE RAINBOW PAINT EFFECTS behind the four characters in the MIDDLE ROW (frames 5,6,7,8). These effects currently touch adjacent frame scenes, causing frame slicing problems. Make these rainbow effects horizontally more COMPACT, about 75-80 percent of their current width, curling behind their own corresponding Tia rather than extending toward the neighbor. Preserve each effect's same arc, sweep or spiral phase, same red/yellow/blue order, same chunky paint-square clusters, same height and motion intention. Shorten the horizontal reach of each rainbow stroke and pull every floating paint square inward toward its own effect. Do not remove whole effects or replace them with new effects.
Precise middle-row placement constraints in the 1448-pixel-wide canvas: frame 5's complete rainbow effect and every paint square must end at or before x=375. Frame 6's entire scene begins at or after x=400, and its effect ends at or before x=710. Frame 7's entire scene begins at or after x=740 and ends at or before x=1070. Frame 8's entire scene begins at or after x=1100 and its effects end by x=1428. The vertical separator strips x=376 through399, x=711 through739, and x=1071 through1099 across the whole middle row must be completely empty alpha-zero transparency. No bright paint, shadow, hair, brush, semitransparent glow, antialiased fringe or stray particles in those strips. Do not solve this by drawing black/colored bars or obvious cut edges; naturally compact the rainbow shapes while leaving the already correct characters untouched.
Keep at least 20 clear transparent pixels at all outside canvas edges; preserve the already corrected frame4 giant golden brush entirely inside the right edge. Use genuine RGBA transparency everywhere in the background. No grid lines, labels, numbers, text, watermark, opaque floor or checkerboard. The final result must look like the same exact animation with slightly more compact middle-row paint arcs and cleanly separated frame gutters.
input_roles: edit target: current approved chibi2 sprite sheet

review.scope: Existing exact sprite-sheet edit. Larger head, shorter body/legs and coarser stepped pixel shading only; original gestures, brush and rainbow progression maintained.
visual_checks: Rest-frame head-to-body proportions are visibly more compact and closer to 2 heads than input.
Original warm-brown hair/bun/gold ribbon, amber eyes, coat/bow/white socks/strapped shoes kept.
Corresponding brush pose gestures and rainbow effect order unchanged; crouched sweep frames remain crouched rather than airborne.
Red/yellow/blue droplets remain in right-hand region in frames 9/10/11 and decrease in size; absent in frame 12.

Additional narrow safety edit: frame4 giant gold brush brought inside right outside edge, frame5 crouching scene moved a little right. All 12 original action gestures, compact proportions and paint/droplet progression retained.

Final narrow correction: only middle-row rainbow effect widths made compact; all 12 character poses, proportions, faces, costumes and physical brushes remain the same. The four original arc/stroke/spiral/splash phases remain readable and the last-row droplets still shrink and vanish.
review.limitations: Head/body ratio is an artistic approximation rather than a rigid measured grid. Root normalization/animated browser review required.

raw_partition_note: Source changed after final middle-effect width edit; rerun shared-cut normalization. Outside canvas edges have no visible alpha>=64 pixels. Middle-row2px vertical bands x369,724,1068 all have zero alpha>=64 pixels. Some tool alpha1 fringe is retained as generated.

Composition locked: exactly 4 equal columns and 3 equal rows, twelve complete distinct nonoverlapping frames, ample transparent gutters around every sprite/effect with no cross-cell trails.
